text:
GruntWorx should inherit the **operational safeguards and shared TaxDome vocabulary**, with its own API budgets, status mapping, and entity identity rules.

1. **Budget API requests at both connection and application level.** Instead throttles per connection/API group first, then against the app-wide budget. That order avoids charging the app budget for work already rejected by the connection limit. Current defaults are **5 docs requests/minute per connection**, **50 entities/minute**, and **500 requests/minute app-wide**; these are Instead settings, not GruntWorx defaults. Unknown groups fall into a budgeted `default` bucket. Byte uploads to signed storage run outside the vendor API throttle. See [throttle configuration](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb:101) and [budgets](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/settings.yml:1816).

   Preserve `Retry-After` handling for both seconds and HTTP dates, plus remaining-budget/reset metrics. The common worker permits **10 retries**, roughly 4½ hours on Sidekiq’s default ladder, but throttled rescheduling resets the count: **this is not a wall-clock deadline**. GruntWorx should subclass the common worker and declare its own throttle. [Worker contract](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:3).

2. **Treat webhooks as a fast path backed by bounded reconciliation.** Instead selects uploaded documents still `sent` after **1 hour** or `processing` after **12 hours**, and stops selecting them after **2 days**, measured from `uploaded_at`. These windows support provider overrides; older records remain unchanged rather than automatically failing. Reconciliation requires a connected grant, an Owner, and provider availability. [Candidate selection](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8).

   Instead batches by entity/year, walks folder pages, then individually fetches candidates missing from the listing. An individual file’s 404 means `archived`; a missing/inaccessible folder is skipped. Unknown statuses skip their row. Page workers make one attempt, leaving failures for the next sweep. Both webhook and reconciliation updates use the **same status application service**, which ignores duplicates/refused transitions and supports recovery from `error` to `processed`. Inherit those guarantees while adapting retrieval to GruntWorx. [Pagination and fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:27), [shared status application](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:35).

3. **Keep failure reasons stable across vendors.** The persisted vocabulary is `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, and `encrypted`. Quota exhaustion maps to `exceeded`; invalid grants/insufficient scopes to `unauthorized`; local policy refusal to `forbidden`. Vendor processing reasons need explicit mappings: Instead maps `password_required` to `encrypted`, while an unknown processing failure remains `error` with no reason.

   GruntWorx should translate its errors into this vocabulary and distinguish terminal refusals from retryable transport failures. Contract/configuration refusals are reported for engineering attention. [Persisted reasons](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:11), [refusal mapping](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/refusals_helper.rb:8).

4. **Make signed-URL cassettes time-aware.** Tagged Instead tests replay with time frozen at the cassette’s original `recorded_at`, so recorded upload expirations retain their original meaning; new recordings use real time. Reuse this mechanism for GruntWorx. Client tests replay real API exchanges and stub responses the developer account cannot produce. [Clock handling](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3), [client test approach](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/unit/tax_preparation/lib/tax_automations/instead/client_spec.rb:5).

   Also preserve streamed uploads without OAuth credentials, signed fields before the file, and the signed content type. Missing/expired buffered targets currently end the send; they are not transparently renewed. [Upload transport](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/base_client.rb:243).

5. **Match entities conservatively before creating them.** Instead first reuses a local entity keyed by firm, account/contact, and entity type across tax years. Name matching considers only active, unlinked entities of the correct firm/type and links **exactly one** candidate. It normalizes punctuation, whitespace and case; business matching also normalizes legal-form spellings and `&`/`and`. Person matching tries swapped first/last names only after the ordinary search finds none; account-name fallback requires a sole contact. Ambiguity produces no automatic link and emits a match outcome metric. [Existing identity lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/find_entity.rb:26), [matching rules](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:49).

   Preserve that caution and the sync race protections: archive unseen entities only after the final page, protect entities created during the pass, and avoid overwriting newer snapshots. GruntWorx’s identity model must determine the actual keys and matching fields. [Sync protections](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/sync_entities_page.rb:43).
